title: Active to Passive Voice: First Practice — Quiz 102
content:
## Active to Passive Voice: First Practice

Change three statements into passive voice.

### Lesson focus

1. Negligence causes many serious accidents.
2. The students are decorating the hall.
3. God has helped me.
4. Most people opposed this.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
